_about: THE ARENA (ARENA lane, VAMILY rule 375, ask lines 402 and 403; Paolo 11/3: 'I forgot about the arena system in Battle Brothers holy shit yes I love that... definitely gonna be a part of the mob... they host an arena with exotic DNA lab shits... make it easier: your accessory thing is X'd out and won't apply as you enter... easier to choose the three people that go in... a tournament, you can bring five'; AMENDED: 'the mob, they're [held together] by fucking duct tape and a thread... barely able to'). ONE FILE A MODDER CAN EDIT: who the Mob puts in the pit and when (Battle Brothers' weighted pool unlocked by arena wins, bb_all/0131_Arena.txt), what it pays (only on a win), the ranks and their small traits, the fifth match and its pit gear, the tournament, the crowd, the power that fails. Every number has its source and its reason; Battle Brothers is the floor and ours is a little easier (his words). The research: records/BOHEMIA_ARENA_HOW_BATTLE_BROTHERS_DOES_IT_11_3_26.md. engine/bohemia_arena.js reads it; nothing else types an arena number. TUNING's table carries these rows as section X.

where.source: VAMILY rule 359(g), rule 375: the Mob hosts it on the Strip
where.why: the arena is a building only in the Mob's own town; a town named here shows the pit on its screen

men.source: bb_all/0620_Dev Blog 142: The Arena.txt: 'limited to fight with just three men of your choice'; Paolo 11/3 'the three people that go into the arena'
men.why: three men, chosen on one screen

men_tournament.source: bb_all/0131_Arena.txt (Arena Tournament: 'You use five men instead of the regular three'); Paolo 11/3 'if it's a tournament then it'll be like you can bring five people'

fights_per_day.source: bb_all/0131_Arena.txt: 'You may compete in the Arena once per day'
fights_per_day.why: one card a day; walk away and tomorrow's card is a different one

accessory_counts.source: bb_all/0620: the arena collar is worn in the accessory slot, so no dog comes in; Paolo 11/3: 'your accessory thing is X'd out and it won't apply as you enter the arena'
accessory_counts.why: no collar to equip: every picked man's accessory is crossed out on the pick screen and stripped from him for the fight

retreat.source: bb_all/0620: 'you can't retreat once a battle has started'
retreat.why: the fight's retreat button is gone in the pit

loot.source: bb_all/0620: 'you won't be able to loot your victims after the battle has ended'; bb_all/0844, 0845: the gladiators' gear 'can't be looted'
loot.why: the spoils screen keeps its recap and drops nothing

count_scale.source: bb_all/0131_Arena.txt (Scaling): 'Number of days passed + Arena victories is a minor factor, but it caps at 50'; the main factor is roster strength, scaled 0.75 to 5; Beginner 0.85, Veteran 1.0, Expert 1.15; every fifth win 'a harder than normal fight (1/3 higher difficulty rating than normal)'
count_scale.why: ours reads the minor factor only (days + 2 x arena wins, full at 60) and Battle Brothers' Beginner factor 0.85 (his 'make it easier'): a card's count runs from its min at the start to min + 0.85 of its range late; a fifth match is a third more

power.source: VAMILY rule 375 AMENDED (ask line 403) and records/BOHEMIA_PAOLO_THE_MOB_RUNS_THE_FARM_AND_THE_ARENA_11_3_26.md: 'when the power fails the farm fails (fewer beasts in the arena...)' (draft, his to change)
power.why: about one day in five the Mob's generator is not fed: the cold rooms fail, the big clones are sick in their pens and off the card, the small ones come out at half the number, and the card says so

value.bb: Hyena: unlocked at 3 or fewer wins, weight 10, 2 to 11 (bb_all/0131 table)
value.why: the cheapest clone line on the farm, a pack with one face; it leaves the pool as you climb, the way Battle Brothers' hyenas do

value.bb: Nomad Outlaw: 0 wins, weight 15, 2 to 6 (bb_all/0131 table); the dev blog's 'captured desert raiders'
value.why: men who tried the Strip and got caught; they fight because the other way out is worse

value.bb: Ifrit: 3 or more wins, weight 5 (bb_all/0131 table); unlocked one win earlier (easier)
value.why: a big clone that kicks round it (rule 370(9): the big beasts are deadly up close)

value.bb: Gladiator: 3 or more wins, weight 15, 2 to 4 (bb_all/0131 table); max 3 for our three men (easier)
value.why: the Mob's own fighters, fed from the farm's meat: they wait on their turn and go for the weakest man (bb_all/0843)

value.says: a feral bull off the farm
value.bb: Frenzied Hyena: 4 or more wins, weight 10 (bb_all/0131 table)
value.why: the bull's charge: shoot it on the way in

value.says: a giant lion from the farm's last litter
value.bb: Mercenary / Swordmaster tier: 5 or more wins, weight 5 (bb_all/0131 table)
value.why: a pride hunter that goes round you to the weak one

value.says: a short-faced bear, thin, a year in a cage
value.bb: Unhold: 6 or more wins, weight 5, 1 to 3 (bb_all/0131 table)
value.why: the farm's Unhold: it heals and it throws a man back

value.says: the Shasta ground sloth, the top of the card
value.bb: Lindwurm: 10 or more wins, weight 5, 1 (bb_all/0131 table)
value.why: the biggest thing the Mob still grows; Paolo's 'the sloth at the top'

value.says: the Mob's champion and his two seconds
value.bb: Gladiator Champion: 15 or more wins, weight 5, 1 with 2 Gladiators (bb_all/0131 table)
value.why: the Mob's own name in the pit; the pay is poor for the danger, as Battle Brothers' champions are (bb_all/0131)

opponents.source: bb_all/0131_Arena.txt, Potential Arena Enemies (the table, Expert counts) and the dev blog's beasts, slaves, captured raiders and professional gladiators; our clones from the Mob's farm (rule 359(g)): the bull, the camel, the bear, the lion, the hyena, the sloth at the top (the ARENA brief)
opponents.why: a weighted pool unlocked by the company's arena wins, the cheap beasts leaving as it climbs; counts sized for three men

purse_per_extra.source: bb_all/0131_Arena.txt: 'the rewards only scale up by a very modest amount for the harder opponents'
purse_per_extra.why: each foe past the card's minimum adds 5 batteries: a bigger card pays a little more, never enough to make a bad card worth it

purse_floor_check.value: 35 to 75 against a one-skull job's 30 and a three-skull job's 90
purse_floor_check.why: Battle Brothers pays the arena 'well for quick battles'; one fight with no road between a one- and a three-skull job

value.name: PIT FIGHTER
value.says: won once in the Mob's pit; it counts his fights and wins

value.name: ARENA FIGHTER
value.says: five wins in the pit; the crowd knows his name

value.name: ARENA VETERAN
value.says: twelve wins; he has gone down in the pit and got back up

ranks.source: bb_all/1561_Pit Fighter.txt (the first win, no stat: it shows the arena fights and wins), bb_all/0132_Arena Fighter.txt (+5 Resolve, 5 wins), bb_all/0134_Arena Veteran.txt (+10 Resolve, 12 wins, +50% to survive struck down); records/target/bb/traits.json carries the same three rows
ranks.why: a man who wins in the pit climbs; the rank is his and it helps in every fight (the shell hands the fight his rank: resolve added to his roll, the Veteran's struck-down death roll halved), as Battle Brothers' do

fifth.source: bb_all/0131_Arena.txt: 5 wins a Gladiator Harness (with padded pieces), 10 a Gladiator Helmet, 15 a Harness with metal pieces, every 5 after a random one; 'the gear reward will wait for you until your next win'
fifth.why: every fifth card is a third harder and offers a piece of pit gear found nowhere else: the harness at five, the helmet at ten, then one of the two; lose it and the prize waits

gladiator_harness.name: a pit-fighter padded vest
gladiator_harness.says: a leather harness off a dead pit fighter, the Mob's mark burned in, patched with a seat belt

gladiator_helmet.name: a pit-fighter full riot helm
gladiator_helmet.says: a welded mask from the showroom's old stage props, the paint gone, a grille you look out through

pit_gear.source: records/target/bb/armor.json body gladiator_harness (bb_all/0844: 40, -4, worth 150) and head gladiator_helmet (bb_all/0845: 225, -13, vision -3, worth 2,200); records/target/bb/armour_names.json their names in the valley
pit_gear.why: Battle Brothers' gladiator gear, already in the game's armour rows (their icons, names and looks), held for the pit: no shop stocks them (engine/bohemia_arena.js reserved, read by the town's restock). Battle Brothers adds padded (+60) or metal (+115) pieces to the harness; those wait on the armour attachments of rule 38 (THE FIGHT GETS DEEP), so ours is the bare harness

tournament.source: bb_all/0133_Arena Tournament.txt ('the Tournament settlement situation for the next 5 days'), bb_all/2016_Tournament (Settlement Situation).txt; bb_all/0131: 'three rounds with no chance to rest or change brothers and gear, but with a possibility to quit after each round. The earlier you quit, the lower the prize. The further you progress, the tougher the opponents. If you win the tournament you will get a named item.'
tournament.why: the Strip holds one for five days about every eighteen; a feed post says so; five men, three rounds; quit after a round and keep what you won; each round draws as if you had five more wins and one more foe; all three wins pay the big prize and a piece of pit gear

crowd.source: bb_all/0620: 'missed that attack with a 95% chance to hit? People will gasp alongside you. Killed that beast with one swift stroke? People will cheer and applaud. Flee from your opponents? People will boo'
crowd.why: the crowd answers what it sees, through the Mob's PA that cuts in and out

names.source: records/target/bb/bohemia_enemies.json names (the clones' board names) and the dev blog's 'captured desert raiders or professional gladiators' (bb_all/0620)
names.why: what the card says for each foe, one and many

looks.source: slices/fight_rig/fight_rig.json (the rig's sheets: 8 facings a row, the stand clip first) and records/target/bb/bohemia_enemies.json beast.rig
looks.why: the card shows each foe in a body the fight's rig draws: the beasts in their own bodies; the caught raiders in road ponchos, the Mob's pit fighters bare-armed, the champion in the Mob's own stripes

value.tournament_on: the mob is running a tournament at the pit, starts today, five days. crews of five, three rounds, a big prize
value.tournament_won: a crew from out of town won the whole pit tournament tonight. three rounds. the mob paid up and looked sick
value.tournament_out: out of towners got knocked out of the pit tournament in round {round}. the mob's people still on top
value.night_won: out of towners beat {foe} in the pit tonight. the mob paid them {paid}. crowd lost its mind
value.night_lost: {foe} won in the pit tonight. the out of towners got carried out. no pay for them

posts.source: VAMILY rule 375 ('a feed post says the Strip hosts one for a few days', the ARENA brief); rule 371 (the radio lives in the feed) and rule 372 (a tweet sounds like a human: plain words, a verb, under 120)
posts.why: the Strip's own account tells the valley a tournament is on and how it ended; words are attempts, draft:true, WORDS may better them
